title: Platform checklist: studio-authoring.first-run-loop still walks the removed Studio landing and Home build chip
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Filing gate ① — a checklist assertion that no longer matches the product (the product is right, the checklist is wrong). Source: fleet (seat L1 nits: N1 of 7172773137 on PR #37340, and N1 of 7172543436 on PR #37249; the seat asked for one card covering both).

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · p3 (checklist prose; no product change, and no gate reads this text) · reach: read on `origin/main` · evidence: read.

## What happens

The P0 checklist item `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` describes two controls that are gone or going:

1. **Line ~35**, the "return to the console Home" step: it walks through the Studio landing 「Studio home」 and its top bar's 「PRODUCT home」 link (`data-testid app-bar-product-home`), with no width qualifier. #37166 (merged as `fbb62e1cc`) removed the Studio landing. `/studio` now opens the last package or Setup → Packages, and #37204 renamed the desktop way home to 「Back to app start page」.
2. **Line ~30 (`steps[1]`)**: it starts from "Home → the build chip" and says that where the catalog serves the build agent the chip "reads 'Build an app' (data-testid home-build-app)". PR #37249 (#37227) removes that chip. That half waits for #37249 to merge.

A checklist runner following these steps today finds no Studio landing, and after #37249, no build chip.

## Expected

Both steps describe the current path: how to reach the console Home from Studio after #37166 (the app start page / product mark as it is now drawn, per width), and the entry the first-run loop starts from once the build chip is gone (「New blank app」, the template, or the marketplace). The item gets a revision entry.

## Done when

- `check:platform-checklist` and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` stay green, with the item's revision bumped.
- A runner can walk the two steps on main without meeting a removed control.

## Why

`first-run-loop` is a P0 item: a QA run following it hits a dead step and either records a false FAIL or stops, so the item stops guarding the first-run path.

Reader: the `area:ux` zone (a4-C) dispatches it, or batches it onto a PR that already edits `studio-authoring.json`. Dedupe: `first-run-loop` (open) → 74 hits, none on this item's text; `studio-authoring.json PRODUCT home` (open) → #37207 (its out-of-scope note; that card closes when PR #37340 lands) and the epic #36890.

Blocked-by: #37249
